execution_counter_scope: Native Bend regression/compiler/proof executions only. Python metadata classifier controls are counted separately in controls.
histogram_limits: Exclusion reasons are nonexclusive; every applicable reason is retained and each test counts once per reason code.
kind: deterministic standalone test-cache eligibility RESEARCH ONLY
limits: Metadata design research only. Scanner controls passed, but eligibility is necessary, not sufficient, for deterministic native behavior or resource fit. No permission to skip; no test/compiler/proof execution or cache pass created. Native compiler/Bun verdicts and stack/memory bounds still need qualification; cached passes alone cannot observe a new resource regression.
policy: Conservative full-module closure; only console print/write native effects allowed. Clock/env/random/process/file/channel/spawn/custom effects/drivers opaque.

resource_regression_design.identity: A future cache key must bind compiler/Bun/OS/architecture, full source/driver/verdict identity and stack/memory/time execution profile; changed identities always require native execution.
resource_regression_design.receipt: Only owned admitted native execution may write a future pass, retaining wall time, peak RSS, cgroup peak/cap/events, CPU allocation and source/tool identities.
resource_regression_design.response: A sample timeout, OOM, missing resource receipt or regression beyond a separately preregistered budget must fail closed and invalidate reuse for the execution profile. Sampling detects some regressions; only complete fresh execution observes every test.
resource_regression_design.sampling: Proposed future policy: always rerun at least one deterministically rotating eligible test per build, plus a nightly complete from-scratch run. Reuse never certifies current resource behavior for unsampled tests.

timing_share.limits: Historical scheduling estimates, not timings on this source/worker and not a measured cache speedup. Missing durations are NOT imputed; percentages describe only known measured test-seconds, not full parallel-job wall time.
source_comments: # Scheduling estimates, not cached test passes.
# Failed/untimed/new programs still run with the sharder fallback.
# Refresh from complete saved logs with scripts/import-test-timings.py,
# or explicitly run the full serial scripts/record-test-timings.sh.
